spec.assertion: Proves the trigger is a 30-PELLET cumulative counter (hitCount:30 over a 10-pellet SG shot ⇒ ~1 proc per 3 shots). Fails under the nearest-wrong readings hitCount:300 ("30 shots") — strictly fewer procs — and hitCount:3 ("counter in shots") — strictly more. Base proc count is bracketed strictly between both.

On the v1 single partless boss the multi-target clause collapses to ONE 202.84% instance. Asserted as: doubling the rider's atkPct strictly raises her total (so a 2× model is detectable), and the shipped model is the single-instance magnitude. The literal 2-enemy payload is it.skip'd — no second enemy entity exists.
Proves the rider damage exists in the skill1 slot and is load-bearing (removing skill1 lowers only her total). Inertness: teammates byte-identical, so the rider cannot be leaking into ally damage.
Every skill1 rider damage event carries coreRate 0. Fails under the nearest-wrong model core:true (riders crit at the caster's rate but get NO core unless the text says "core strike damage").

spec.kitLine: 5+ pellets hit w/ single normal atk
spec.assertion: The >=5-of-10 landed-pellet predicate has no engine primitive (SG landing is statistical), so it cannot be discriminated from an always-on per-shot trigger — it.skip'd with that reason. What IS asserted: the buff fires per-shot and is self-scoped.

Proves (a) the buff exists as self reloadSpeedPct, (b) it is TIME-bounded — finite expiresFrame and NO durationShots, killing the "for N round(s)" mis-read and the permanent mis-read, (c) reload speed IS damage: zeroing the value strictly lowers her total (it gates shots fired). Inertness: no teammate ever receives it.

spec.kitLine: hitting 30 times with pellets in FB
spec.assertion: Proves the block is FULL-BURST gated: every 11.22 atkPct application frame falls inside a fullBurstStart→fullBurstEnd window. Non-vacuous because the fixture is separately asserted to have BOTH in-FB and out-of-FB firing time. Fails under the nearest-wrong "fires all fight" model (fbGate deleted), which strictly raises her total.

Proves the refill is a partial (1-round) instantReload, not a full magazine: removing the fraction (full refill) yields a total ≥ base, so the two models are distinguishable in the shots-fired economy.
Proves magnitude 11.22, maxStacks exactly 5 (not unbounded), stacks never exceeding 5, and self-only targeting. Fails under an unstacked/uncapped model and under an ally-scoped model.

Proves stat attackDamagePct (the Damage Up bucket) at 10.56, SELF target, finite 10s expiry with no durationShots. The ally-scoped counterfactual demonstrably moves teammates, while the faithful model moves nobody else.
Proves stat critDamagePct at 88.17, SELF target, 10s time-bounded. Fails under a generic-crit-rate mis-encoding (wrong stat key never emits) and under the allies-scoped model (teammates move).
Proves the burst nuke exists, is load-bearing (halving atkPct lowers her total), is FB-EXEMPT (fbMajorApplied falsy — a burst cast lands before the FB window opens), and takes no core bucket.
Single-boss fixture: "all enemies" collapses to one instance; no multi-enemy discrimination is possible. Covered by the same it.skip as skill1's 2-target clause.

No buff she casts targets anyone but herself (she is a pure selfish Attacker — every kit line reads "Affects self"), and she inflicts no boss-held debuff carrying any of her four magnitudes. Fails the moment any line is mis-scoped to allies or to the enemy.
Her charge bucket is exactly 0 — she is a non-charge SG, so any chargeDamage leakage indicates a mis-encoded weapon model.

fixtures: controlComp('privaty-unkind-maid', true) — liter B1 / crown B2 / carry B3 / helm B3, boss Fire, focus carry. The fixed-B3 flag is TRUE because she is Burst III with a 40s cooldown: a lone B3 makes ZERO Full Bursts, and BOTH her burst block (self ATK-damage + crit-damage buffs, 1066.66% nuke) AND her skill2b in-Full-Burst 30-pellet block are unreachable without B1+B2 completing the chain. The helm B3 slot's buffs do not confound any assertion here because every load-bearing assertion is either event-structural (stat/value/targetSlug/frame-in-FB-window/coreRate/fbMajorApplied) or a same-fixture A/B against a withPatchedOverride counterfactual, so any constant teammate contribution cancels. Deterministic, no seed. Runs are hoisted: 1 base + 7 counterfactual runs (slow/fast hitCount, doubled rider, no-skill1, zeroed reload speed, ungated FB, full refill, allies-scoped burst, halved nuke) — under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: skill1 'Affects 2 enemy unit(s) nearest to the crosshair' — the v1 boss is a single partless enemy; resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns [] and there is no second enemy entity, so the 2-target payload is structurally unobservable. Modeled as ONE instance; the multi-target clause is it.skip'd.

skill2a '5 or more pellets hit with a single normal attack' — no engine primitive exposes a per-shot LANDED-pellet count to a block gate, and SG landing is statistical, so the >=5/10 condition cannot be discriminated from an unconditional per-shot trigger. it.skip'd as MEASUREMENT-GATED (needs a landed-pellet-count gate primitive).

Pellet-counter semantics for BOTH 30-pellet triggers — whether a partially-landing shot advances the counter by its LANDED pellets or by the nominal 10 is a modeling choice the kit text cannot settle (⚑). The engine's hitCount counts engine hits; the interaction with the SG landing fraction is unobservable without a pellet-level counter tap. it.skip'd, flagged, not asserted.
burst 'Affects all enemies' — same single-boss collapse as skill1's 2-target clause; no multi-enemy discrimination possible.

NOT a gap but ⚑-flagged: reloadFrames 141 is a known-unreliable datamine field, so the ABSOLUTE magnitude of the reload-speed buff's damage contribution is not asserted — only its SIGN (zeroing it strictly lowers her total).
